01_Risk_Register.xlsx.name: Risk Register
01_Risk_Register.xlsx.desc: Full risk register with probability/impact scoring, mitigation tracking, and status dropdowns. 30 rows, auto-IDs.

02_Action_Item_Log.xlsx.name: Action Item Log
02_Action_Item_Log.xlsx.desc: Track all open action items by meeting source, owner, due date, and status. Auto-generates AI-XXX IDs.

03_Change_Order_Log.xlsx.name: Change Order Log
03_Change_Order_Log.xlsx.desc: Log all change events from identification through execution with running contract value totals.

04_Meeting_Agenda_and_Minutes.xlsx.desc: Three-tab workbook: OAC Agenda (12 standard items), Meeting Minutes (decisions/action items/carry-forward), Design Review Agenda.

07_Budget_Tracker.xlsx.name: Budget Tracker + Contingency Log
07_Budget_Tracker.xlsx.desc: Two-tab: full project budget by category with variance and % complete, plus contingency draw-down log.

08_Pay_App_Review_Checklist.xlsx.name: Pay Application Review Checklist
08_Pay_App_Review_Checklist.xlsx.desc: SOV, lien waiver, field verification, and draw package checklist for certifying contractor pay applications.

09_Punch_List_Log.xlsx.name: Punch List Log
09_Punch_List_Log.xlsx.desc: 200-row punch list with location, trade, priority, credit tracking, and status dropdowns.

10_Weekly_Report_Template.xlsx.name: Weekly Report Template
10_Weekly_Report_Template.xlsx.desc: Health summary, schedule milestones, budget overview, top issues, and action items.

11_Vendor_Evaluation_Matrix.xlsx.name: Vendor Evaluation Matrix
11_Vendor_Evaluation_Matrix.xlsx.desc: Weighted scoring matrix for up to 4 vendors across 7 criteria with auto-calculated totals.

12_FFE_Procurement_Tracker.xlsx.name: FF&E / OS&E Procurement Tracker
12_FFE_Procurement_Tracker.xlsx.desc: 100-row tracker with lead time calculation, delivery tracking, and furnished/installed-by dropdowns.
